Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 37 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Tanay is sitting on a chair in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay stands up.]

Tanay: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Tanay searches for his lost ball.]

Sunita (excited): "Yes, all right."

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Tanay: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay starts crying.]

Sunita (excited): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay carries his school bag on his back.]

Tanay: "Okay, Mom."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Tanay: "How beautiful!"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Tanay: "What happened?"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Tanay (softly): "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The bathroom - Day

[Tanay stands in the bathroom. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Tanay brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Sunita: "One more time!"

[Tanay takes a quick bath.]

Tanay: "What a day to remember!"
